purpose: v1.0.0's M2 correctly added tests/integration/function-execute-acl-guard.test.ts and correctly did NOT authorize any change to tests/database-entrypoint-safety.test.ts's closed-world integration inventory. That inventory is a mechanical consequence of which files exist under tests/integration/**, and adding a THIRD file to that directory made it stale by construction — proven live: the dispatched P1A Validation run (33681916900) against the v1.0.0 candidate (ad9c305) failed at the 'Database target safety suite' step, BEFORE Start Supabase Local / Run Integration Tests ever executed, so v1.0.0's own M2 test was never actually exercised on real Postgres in CI. This authority is the narrow, deterministic companion fix: update the closed-world inventory to reflect the file that already exists and is already correct, and nothing else.

required_changes: 'the INTEGRATION config still collects both integration files' -> exact three-file closed-world equality (tests/integration/function-execute-acl-guard.test.ts, tests/integration/investments.service.test.ts, tests/integration/rls.test.ts, sorted), renamed to no longer say 'both'

the it.each guard-first invariant (import './_guard' as the first import) extended to include tests/integration/function-execute-acl-guard.test.ts, preserving exact closed-world semantics (no glob, no directory scan)
'the integration suite still collects its 49 tests' -> mechanically re-derived count, with the test name and any comment referencing 49 updated to the freshly derived number

the DEFAULT config still collects zero tests/integration/** files (untouched by this remediation)
the fail-closed per-file guard invariant (each file's first import is './_guard')

any change to database bootstrap, migrations, or Supabase provisioning even if a later P1A run fails for one of those reasons — such a failure requires STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_ADJUDICATION, not scope expansion under this authority
